netboxUrl.description: Base URL of your NetBox instance, e.g. https://netbox.example.com

netboxToken.description: Read access to dcim devices, interfaces and cables.

chassisMacField.description: Name of the NetBox device custom field holding the chassis MAC. This is how a NetBox device is matched to the network device Dynatrace already discovered over SNMP. Devices without it fall back to their management interface MAC; devices with neither are reported but create no Smartscape node.

hostRoles.displayName: Roles that are hosts, not network devices
hostRoles.description: Comma-separated NetBox role slugs. Devices with these roles are reported in the roster but never become network devices in Smartscape, and cables to them create no edges.

emitNeighbors.displayName: Draw neighbor edges from NetBox cabling
emitNeighbors.description: Turns connected data cables between active network devices into Smartscape neighbor (calls) edges. Where SNMP Autodiscovery already discovers neighbors over LLDP/CDP, edges for the same cable merge rather than duplicate; turn this off if you only want NetBox's device metadata.

intervalSeconds.description: NetBox is a CMDB; it changes on human timescales. 300s keeps load on NetBox low.
